items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: my jive cousin, he was a booking agent, he says, 'I need a bass player.

ctx.x: Well, on graduation day, the 18th of June, everyone -- all the males, the male graduates, were supposed to have white suits and white shoes. I'd had my white suit made up, sharkskin, Continental Tailoring, on Fifth Street. Mother gave me money to get my white shoes. Instead of me getting the white shoes, on lunch hour I went across the street on the Island, got down and started shooting some dice. Lost my shoe money. And when time come for the exercise, I'm in there, playing my solo with black shoes on. I'm the…
So the next day, my jive cousin, he was a booking agent, he says, 'I need a bass player. We're going to Tempe with a show. I'm taking a show up. I'm taking some chorus
girls and a band." I say, "I'll take the job," because I'd had this little experience with the Woodman Brothers. He said, "Where you going to get a bass?" I say, "I don't know."
